posts.title: Abandonment crisis
posts.description: I had an abandonment crisis today. During these crises, I panic irrationally about the possibility, or the reality, that someone might leave me. It feels like being a terrified child, unable for a while to reconnect with reality, while not even realizing I drifted away from it. posts.title: Another newcomer
posts.description: Another newcomer on Bearblog. Astonishing. After far too much reflection, punctuated by far too many coffees, I’m still not quite sure what will be written here. It’s unlikely that I’ll write articles with catchy titles and assertive content.
